description: This file defines a UserService class for managing user accounts, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting users, as well as assigning roles.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user management functionalities such as retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of user records with role management.

methods.name: Optional[User] get(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their user ID.

methods.name: list(self, page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: List users with pagination, returning a subset of users and total count.

methods.name: User create(self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: list[str] | None = None)
methods.description: Create a new user with specified details and roles, auto-creating roles if they do not exist.

methods.name: User update(self, user: User, full_name: str | None = None, password: str | None = None, is_active: bool | None = None, roles: list[str] | None = None)
methods.description: Update user's full name, password, active status, and roles; auto-creating missing roles.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: list[str] | None = None) /
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: list[str] | None = None)

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^    def list(self, page: int, per_page: int):$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, user: User, full_name: str | None = None, password: str | None = None, is_a/
ctags.signature: (self, user: User, full_name: str | None = None, password: str | None = None, is_active: bool | None = None, roles: list[str] | None = None)
